## Why

Generation config validation checks basic shape, but does not reject duplicate sweep axes or arithmetic overflow in the sweep cardinality. Invalid or excessively large inputs should fail clearly before expensive allocation or output.

## Files

Obfuscator/Obfuscator.cs; Obfuscator/DataGenerator.cs; Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs; generator examples and README.

## Failing tests

Add cases for duplicate axes, invalid discrete values/config combinations, sweep-cardinality overflow, and supported fixed/sweep/max behavior including seeded output.

## Implement

Define validation for sweep axis uniqueness, referenced values, relevant numeric and percentage fields, and checked sweep cardinality before row expansion. Preserve documented row modes and avoid introducing an arbitrary size cap without a documented rationale.

## Check

Run focused config/generator tests, compare the frozen semiconductor fixture, then run the full solution test suite.
